voiceText: Fim do mês e ainda tem que pensar na janta.
prompt: A 10-second continuous shot. A person sits at a kitchen table, elbows down, head resting in one hand, staring at nothing. On the table: an empty plate, a glass of water. Behind, the kitchen is quiet and dim. After a moment the hand reaches out and slowly pulls the empty plate closer. Warm low evening light, real home kitchen, honest and unglamorous. Very slow tired motion. Audio: only natural ambience — a chair creaking, the plate sliding on the table, deep quiet. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Última semana do mês.

O cansaço não é de hoje — é acumulado desde o dia 1.

E ainda assim alguém tem que decidir o que vai ter pra comer.
